description: The three video types Motion Lab produces, and only these. A brief declares one in deliverables.video_type; scripts/studio.py new requires it and validate enforces it. Any type can be a member of a series (specs/series-spec.json), alone or mixed with the others.
margin_note: Each nominal range may be missed by this many seconds at either end. The allowed window is nominal.min - margin to nominal.max + margin; a type with no nominal max has no upper limit.

reel.name: Instagram reel
reel.note: 45 s is preferred; go toward 60 s only for a complicated topic that needs more animated beats, not more words.

long-reel.name: Long Instagram reel
long-reel.note: Portrait, up to 3 minutes. Needs a re-hook about every 35-45 s; reel-loop fits only its short end.

youtube.name: YouTube video
youtube.note: Landscape, over 3 minutes, no upper limit. Needs a re-hook every 60-90 s.
